1.consolidated_definition: dep. Ejercicio aeróbico. Ejercicio especial aeróbico en el que la persona da saltos abriendo las piernas a la vez que levanta y baja los brazos. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Luego sigue una rutina de jumping jacks, abdominales, squads, lagartijas (push ups). Completado el ciclo, realizan los mismos ejercicios a mayor velocidad
1.en_consolidated_definition: Aerobic exercise. A specific aerobic exercise in which the person jumps while spreading their legs and simultaneously raises and lowers their arms. This is often followed by a routine of jumping jacks, abdominal exercises, squats, and push-ups (also known as lagartijas). After completing the cycle, the same exercises are performed at an increased speed.
